# Dough Intent Coverage report

- **Invocation start:** 2026-11-21 13:55:38 +08 (host clock; 1795240538000 Unix epoch ms).
- **Story:** `.planning/seeds/SEED-413-renovate-dashboard-unit-tests.md#mount-story-review-changes-panel`, key example "Details behind the eye" (seed lines 719-720). Plan: `.planning/slice-plans/748-mount-story-review-changes-panel/PLAN.md` (slice 4).
- **Revision:** 68745734e22d71fa7973b971cc1a51ca19163da2 (product code equals 0b271aad5).
- **Promise:** "A workspace review opens on the diff with its details hidden. The eye reveals and hides them without moving the reading place." The probe targets the second sentence: the code pane's scroll position stays put when the eye toggles.

## Verdict: Caught

The maintained assertion `expect(review.codeScrollTop(second)).toBe(readingAt)` at
`dashboard/frontend-tests/review/story-review-details.spec.ts:64:40`, in the case
"a workspace review opens on the diff and keeps its place while the eye reveals and hides its details",
failed with `expected +0 to be 120` after the eye revealed the details. A separate scratch witness
saw the same wrong behavior on that path.

Limit of the claim: the catch happened on the **reveal** transition. The fault also resets the position on hide,
but the test stopped at line 64, so the hide-side check at line 69 was not reached in this run. Its catch on hide
alone is unproven.

**Next proof action:** none needed for the reveal path. If you want the hide path proven alone, run a separate
probe that resets the position only when hiding.

No planned repair or earlier disposition matches this result. The probe needs no new repair.

## Setup

- Scratch checkout: `git worktree add --detach /Users/terryyin/.claude/jobs/5ab12b37/tmp/ic-scratch 68745734e...`,
  then `npm ci` (Node v24.21.0, which matches `.node-version`). `npm ci` exited 0.
- Pre-probe state: `git status --porcelain` was empty and HEAD was 68745734e22d71fa7973b971cc1a51ca19163da2.
- The suggested promise, fault, assertion and command all matched the revision and were used without change.

## Fault

`dashboard/src/StoryReview.tsx`, in the `details.onShow` handler, after `setDetailsShown(show);` this line was added:

```ts
eye.current?.closest("section")?.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>(".story-review-code").forEach((pane) => { pane.scrollTop = 0; });
```

Each eye toggle resets every code pane in the review panel to the top. Fixtures and assertions were left unchanged.

## Commands and results

All runs used this command in the scratch checkout:
`caffeinate -s -i env -u NO_COLOR -u FORCE_COLOR -u GIT_ALTERNATE_OBJECT_DIRECTORIES npm run --silent test:dashboard:frontend -- <spec> --workers=<n>`
with the default reporter and default timeouts.

1. **Baseline:** `story-review-details.spec.ts --workers=2` exited 0. All 3 tests passed, including the target case (3905 ms). Duration was 10.88 s.
2. **Faulted:** the same command exited 1. The target case failed with `AssertionError: expected +0 to be 120` at `story-review-details.spec.ts:64:40`. The other two cases passed. Duration was 9.51 s.
3. **Independent witness under the fault:** a scratch-only spec, `dashboard/frontend-tests/review/zz-ic-witness.spec.ts`, ran with `--workers=1` and was deleted afterwards. It mounted the same workspace review, chose `second.txt`, scrolled the code to 120, clicked the eye (`Show review details`) and then `Hide review details`, and read the raw DOM `scrollTop` of `.story-review-code` with no assertions. Output: `before=120 afterReveal=0 afterHide=0`. The reading place moved on both transitions.
   - The first witness attempt used a wrong selector and read `undefined`. I fixed the selector and reran the witness.
4. **Witness after restoration:** `before=120 afterReveal=120 afterHide=120`. The wrong behavior is gone.
5. **Restored maintained run:** `story-review-details.spec.ts --workers=2` exited 0. All 3 tests passed (target case 2941 ms). Duration was 9.04 s.

## Restoration evidence

- I restored `dashboard/src/StoryReview.tsx` with `git checkout --` and deleted the witness spec.
- In the scratch checkout, `git status --porcelain` was then empty and `git diff --stat` showed nothing. The only ignored, non-`node_modules` output was `dashboard/frontend-tests/test-results/`.
- After the restore, both the witness (run 4) and the maintained run (run 5) passed.
- I removed the scratch worktree with `git worktree remove --force`. `git worktree list` no longer shows it.
- I did not edit the execution worktree. It currently shows ` M .planning/seeds/SEED-413-renovate-dashboard-unit-tests.md`. That change did not come from this probe, which made every edit in the scratch checkout. It is probably the caller's own work in progress.

## Cost

- **Test runtime.** Measured from the Vitest "Duration" lines, in seconds of wall time per run: baseline 10.88 s, faulted 9.51 s, restored 9.04 s, about 29.4 s in total for the maintained spec. The witness runs (3 runs: 2 faulted, 1 restored) were not timed separately. I estimate about 10 s each from the similar single-file runs.
- **Human effort.** 0 minutes (estimated). No human took part during the probe.
- **Agent effort.** Unavailable. No separately supported token or tool-time measure was exposed to this agent. About 16 tool calls were made, which I counted from this session.


- **Invocation-to-report elapsed.** 191097 ms (measured), from 1795240538000 to 1795240729097 in Unix epoch ms. The end clock was sampled after writing the prepared report body.


Wrap-up disposition: 68745734e22d71fa7973b971cc1a51ca19163da2, Caught, no follow-up.
